design.fit: Fit centered ridge to within-root deployed-score residuals. By original run seed, SHA256(seed)[:4] big-endian mod 5 == 0 is held out for offline selection. Four validation subgroups use digest byte [4] mod 4. No refit on holdout.
design.selection: Require Act 1 mean held-out gain > 0, each of the four subgroup means >= 0, and raw weight deltas >= -0.50 for take:value, Snakebite, Predator and Bubble Bubble. Among qualifiers maximize gain, then ridge, then prefer smaller alpha. If eligible, pair this Act 1 fit with the best Act 2+3 fit at alpha <= 0.75, and also run the same late fit alone. Otherwise test two late-only fits, best at alpha 0.25 and best at alpha 0.50. Rank late fits by the same tie rule. Report the full grid.
design.dev_gate: 384/384 matched complete nonabandoned starts for all three bundles. Candidate paired total-floor CI lower endpoint > 0 and no decreases in Act 1 clear, Act 2 boss entry or Act 2 clear counts. For late-only arms require exact per-seed Act 1 boss entry and clear agreement. If both pass select larger mean floor gain, ties prefer the smaller late alpha then the late-only arm.
design.ci: Total floors = 17*(terminal_act-1)+terminal_floor. Use 30000 paired seed bootstrap replicates with replacement, identical draws for both contrasts, NumPy default_rng(261123), two-sided Bonferroni percentile interval [0.0125,0.9875] for each contrast.
design.conditional: Count runs with Act 1 clear and Act 2 boss entry / runs with Act 1 clear in that arm.
design.handoff: A dev pass qualifies the frozen strategy for later integration with v5. Sealed panels are outside this dev experiment.

paired_rows.status: Each arm of each listed seed is a complete nonabandoned native game.

interpretation.act1_choice: No Act 1 candidate met both preregistered criteria. The 32/0.50 fit had the greatest held-out gain (+0.3391), but shifted take:value by -1.5866 and Predator by -0.8455. Only 128/0.20 met the monitored weight floor, and its held-out gain was negative (-0.0031).
interpretation.result: Both late-only policies preserved every Act 1 milestone pair and all 2,753 Act 1 draft records. At 64/0.25 the two additional Act 2 boss entries came from two paired gains without losses. At 64/0.50 there were four gains and six losses in boss entry and three gains versus two losses in Act 2 clear.
interpretation.decision: The floor interval crosses zero at both strengths. The medium arm also lost two Act 2 boss entries. Neither qualifies for v5 integration.

quality.bundle_loading: load_bundle verified each model checksum and DeployedController loaded every arm.
quality.headless_execution: play_episode, natural A10 start, macro seed 7103 + index, independent fresh host per episode, explain_drafts=True. Up to one fresh host retry on an incomplete or abandoned run.

historical_score_replay.source: All natural card rewards from the 1024 locked original training starts
historical_score_replay.method: Compared every action, prior, strategy term total and overall total (binary64 hex) to the original implementation. Checked original factual action, current ungated v4 in all three acts, and both candidates in Act 1.

reproduction.packaging: Call freeze_bundle with load_bundle(v4) settings, roles=[candidate] and strategy_model=<committed candidate path>. Candidate JSON differs from v4 only by card_residuals_by_act. Deltas are in raw strategy-weight units, before deployed card strength 0.55.
